def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [
        (logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
        (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
        (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call"),
    ]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")

    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_call_only.shape == logp_with_result.shape and logp_no_call.shape == logp_with_result.shape):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have the same shape")

    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    # Compute normalized weights
    horizon = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Compute weighted losses
    loss_with = - (logp_with_result * norm_weights).sum(axis=1)
    loss_call_only = - (logp_call_only * norm_weights).sum(axis=1)
    loss_no_call = - (logp_no_call * norm_weights).sum(axis=1)

    # Compute L_minus as min of no-call and call-only losses
    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)

    # Compute margin
    margin = L_minus - loss_with

    # Keep if margin >= threshold
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
